title: Fe3O4/cellulose/Zn-MOF: introduction of a new catalyst for the synthesis of tetrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine-6-carbonitriles and diphenyl-1,3-thiazoles under solvent-free conditions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47826-47839
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07068F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maryam JahangirVazifeh, Mohammad Hossein Abdollahi-Basir, Bahman Sharifzadeh, Farhad Shirini
In this research, a novel, magnetically recoverable heterogeneous catalyst, Fe3O4/cellulose/Zn-MOF, was synthesized, thoroughly characterized and used in the synthesis of diphenyl-1,3-thiazoles and tetrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine-6-carbonitriles.
